questions.stem: __________ eclipse is formed when the earth passes between the sun and the moon.
explanation_steps: A **lunar eclipse** occurs when the Earth moves between the Sun and the Moon, casting its shadow on the Moon. This can only happen during a full moon.

explanation_steps:

**Result:** 80.

questions.stem: One of the following rays has higher frequency, shorter wavelength and carries the most energy compared to the other rays.
explanation_steps: In the electromagnetic spectrum, **Gamma rays** have the highest frequency, the shortest wavelength, and the highest energy per photon. The order from highest to lowest energy is: Gamma > X-ray > UV > Visible > IR > Microwave > Radio.

questions.stem: In an elastic collision between two objects the

options.A: momentum before collision is smaller than momentum after collision.
options.B: momentum before collision and momentum after collision are zero.
options.C: kinetic energy before collision is equal to kinetic energy after collision.
options.D: kinetic energy before collision is larger than kinetic energy after collision.
options.E: momentum before collision is larger than momentum after collision.
